breaking_changes: async: Async 0.x to 3.x removes or changes legacy collection/control-flow edge cases and callback timing assumptions.
body-parser: body-parser 2.x raises runtime requirements and may change parser dependency behavior from 1.x.
compression: compression 1.x minor upgrade, primarily middleware dependency/runtime changes.
cron: cron 1.x to 4.x changes job construction, time zone handling, and Node runtime support.
express: Express 4.x to 5.x changes routing/path matching, middleware error propagation, and removed/deprecated APIs.
fluent-ffmpeg: fluent-ffmpeg is deprecated; upgrade remains within 2.x but package support status is high risk.
influx: influx 4.x to 5.x can affect client construction, query APIs, and response shapes.
jsonwebtoken: jsonwebtoken 5.x to 9.x changes supported algorithms/default validation behavior and runtime support.
memcached: memcached patch/minor update; API risk is low but cache behavior should be smoke tested.
minimist: minimist 1.1 to 1.2 is API-compatible for common parsing; security-driven update.
socket.io: Socket.IO 1.x to 4.x changes server/client protocol compatibility, middleware signatures, and connection APIs.
socketio-jwt: socketio-jwt latest matches wanted range, but it integrates with old Socket.IO middleware semantics.
xml2js: xml2js 0.4 to 0.6 is mostly compatible but parser defaults and dependency behavior should be checked.
mongodb: MongoDB driver 2.x to 7.x replaces connection APIs and cursor/collection method behavior.
xmlbuilder: xmlbuilder 2.x to 15.x has broad API/runtime changes and package evolution.
archiver: archiver 0.14 to 8.x changes stream/error behavior and Node runtime requirements.
stream-buffers: stream-buffers 2.x to 3.x major upgrade; stream semantics should be validated.
csv: csv 0.4 to 6.x changes package exports and parser/stringifier APIs.
moment: moment 2.x minor upgrade; API risk is low, but bundled static moment copies may drift.
gc-stats: gc-stats latest matches wanted range but package is deprecated/native and can be Node-version sensitive.
handlebars: handlebars 3.x to 4.x changes template/compiler behavior and fixes prototype-access security defaults.
nodemailer: nodemailer 1.x to 9.x changes transport setup, authentication, and message APIs.
on-finished: on-finished latest matches wanted range; low direct API risk.
request: request latest matches wanted range but package is deprecated and should be treated as replacement risk.
send: send 0.12 to 1.x changes static file serving internals and dependency/runtime requirements.
sharp: sharp 0.14 to 0.35 changes native install/runtime requirements and image pipeline behavior.
socket.io-client: Socket.IO client 1.x to 4.x must remain protocol-compatible with the server.
uglify-js: uglify-js 2.x to 3.x changes minifier options and output behavior.
uuid: uuid 2.x to 14.x changes module exports and UUID function import style.
walk: walk latest matches wanted range; low direct API risk.
winston: winston 1.x to 3.x replaces logger/transport APIs and configuration shape.
winston-logstash: winston-logstash 0.3 to 2.x must be checked with Winston 3 transport compatibility.
risk_summary.notes: Repository is a multi-package Node.js/CommonJS codebase with npm package.json manifests and no root lockfile discovered. npm outdated was run per package directory; Utilities had no outdated result. Several installed node_modules versions do not match manifest wanted ranges, so manifests are the authoritative upgrade surface.
